entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I'm a bit overwhelmed. I ordered a jersey and I think I need to send it back. The website was so confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, hold on. It's VF-8675309. I just don't understand what to do. I got the jersey and it's the wrong size.

Okay, thank you for that. I see the order was delivered 17 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the item, or a preference issue like the fit?
It's the fit. It's just way too tight. I thought I ordered the right one, but I guess not. I'd love to exchange it for a bigger size if possible. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, I've got it here. So, because you received the jersey only 17 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return policy.
Oh, 90 days? That's great! I was so worried I had missed the window. I couldn't figure it out on the website.
Not a problem at all. We can definitely set up an exchange for the correct size or process a full refund, whichever you prefer.
An exchange would be perfect! That's such a relief. Thank you so much for making this simple.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the exchange in our system and sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just package the jersey that is too tight and drop it off with the carrier. We'll send out the new size as soon as we see the return has been scanned. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Charlie. You've been a huge help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
